description_en: This API initiates a call directly, bypassing the outbound call scheduling system. It is available only to users on the whitelist
description_zh: 不经过外呼调度系统直接发起呼叫。该接口只针对白名单用户开放
kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot start-job --instance-id da37319b-6c83-4268-9f19-814aed62e401 --job-group-id 4f21446e-324e-46f2-bf62-7f341fb004ea --scenario-id af81a389-91f0-4157-8d82-720edd02b66a --job-json 'extras_:_value_:_测试_,_key_:_测试_,_key_:_ServiceId_,_value_:_null_,_key_:_TenantId_,_value_:_null_,_contacts_:_phonenumber_:_19800000000_,_name_:_张三_,_priority_:_5,_referenceId_:_C01' --script-id 1eeae263-54ca-4a52-ae14-62da58f3c473 --calling-number 057100000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartJob

parameters.help_en: Scenario ID. This field supports backward compatibility with legacy outbound calling features. You can omit it
parameters.help_zh: 场景ID，为了兼容旧版外呼功能。可不填
parameters.name: scenario_id

parameters.help_en:
Job data, which includes the following fields:

extras // Optional extra information

- key // Key for a custom variable

- value // Value for a custom variable

contacts // Required contact information for the callee

- phoneNumber // Required phone number of the callee

- referenceId // Required contact ID (user-defined) to avoid duplicate names

- role // Optional role of this contact in the outbound call scenario. If omitted, no role distinction is made

- honorific // Optional honorific for the contact

- name // Optional name of the contact
parameters.help_zh:
作业数据,包含以下内容

extras //额外信息，非必填
- key //自定义变量内容 key
- value //自定义变量内容 value

contacts // 必填字段，被叫人联系信息
- phoneNumber // 必填字段，被叫人电话号码 
- referenceId // 必填字段，联系人 ID（用户自定义），主要是避免重名现象
- role //非必填字段，该联系人在此外呼业务中的角色，不指定则不区分
- honorific //非必填字段，联系人尊称
- name //非必填字段，联系人姓名
parameters.name: job_json
